exitSearch.result: No later sale, Plains buyout, signed pending transfer or disposition of OMSPB's 35% POPB interest was found. Stonepeak remains attributable through its current portfolio page and the Oryx-side interest is active in the June 2026 evidence. QIA's 2019 entry is proven, but no direct source resolved whether QIA still owned an indirect interest at the cutoff.
